# Vendored browser libraries

These pinned production browser builds are served locally, so the Dertek UI has no runtime CDN dependency.

- Vue 3.5.42 — `vue.global.prod.js` — MIT — https://github.com/vuejs/core
- Vue Router 5.3.1 — `vue-router.global.prod.js` — MIT — https://github.com/vuejs/router
- Pinia 4.0.3 — `pinia.iife.js` — MIT — https://github.com/vuejs/pinia
- Bootstrap 5.3.8 — `bootstrap.min.css` and `bootstrap.bundle.min.js` — MIT — https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap

Original packages are distributed through jsDelivr. Update versions together only after checking browser compatibility.
